title: Plus History Downgrade Credit
content:
**Q. What is the Plus history downgrade credit?**
A. A credit added to the downgrade difference refund of a Northgate Memberships membership that has paid several years at the Plus annual fee. A membership with no current-year Plus premium gets no downgrade difference refund at all.

**Q. How are Plus history years counted?**
A. The Plus history years are the renewal and new membership fees charged at the Plus annual fee of 130.00 dollars, less those refunded as duplicate charges. Only charges of exactly 130.00 count, and a duplicate-charge refund of 130.00 takes one away.

**Q. What does the credit come to?**
A. Four or more Plus history years add a Plus history downgrade credit of 4.00 dollars, two or three add 2.00 dollars, and fewer add nothing.

| Plus history years | Plus history downgrade credit |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 4.00 |
| 2 or 3 | 2.00 |
| 0 or 1 | nothing |

**Q. Hypothetical: one new membership fee of 130.00 and three renewal fees of 130.00?**
A. Four Plus history years — 4.00.

**Q. Hypothetical: the same ledger, one of the renewal fees having been refunded as a duplicate charge?**
A. Three Plus history years — 2.00.

**Q. Hypothetical: a membership upgraded mid-year, whose renewal fees were charged at 65.00 and which paid an upgrade difference charge?**
A. None of those charges is a renewal or new membership fee at 130.00 — no Plus history years from them.
